author: Aaij, R. and others
title: Angular analysis of the $B^{0} \to K^{*0} \mu^{+} \mu^{-}$ decay using 3 fb$^{-1}$ of integrated luminosity
abstract: An angular analysis of the $B^{0}\to K^{*0}(\to K^{+}\pi^{-})\mu^{+}\mu^{-}$ decay is presented. The dataset corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 3.0 fb$^{-1}$ of $pp$ collision data collected at the LHCb experiment. The complete angular information from the decay is used to determine $CP$-averaged angular observables.
